Visualizes task attributes (Urgency, Importance, Effort, Due Date)

disambiguation: Not a standard Kanban board; it visualizes and edits a structured Markdown todo file.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that renders a Markdown todo file as a Google Tasks–style board — synced in real time, in both directions.
problem: It addresses the need for a visual, interactive representation of structured Markdown todo lists, especially when managed by AI agents.

relations.evidence: Companion skill: skills/agentboard-sync/SKILL.md is a ready-to-use Claude Code skill that produces this format

summary: AgentBoard renders a Markdown todo file as a Google Tasks-style board, allowing real-time, two-way synchronization between the visual board and the source file.
